message.content:
Based on my search, **The Walking Dead comic came first**.

The comic book series was created by writer Robert Kirkman and artist Tony Moore, with **Issue #1 originally published on October 8, 2003** by Image Comics.

The AMC television adaptation came much later, **premiering on October 31, 2010** — nearly seven years after the comic debuted. The show was developed by Frank Darabont and was based on the comic book series, though it followed a different storyline with various changes and additions.
